name: period-brief
title: Reporting period brief
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM periods ORDER BY code

sections.title: Results and missing submissions
sections.sql: SELECT project,indicator,unit,target,actual,accepted,pending,rejected FROM v_reporting_desk WHERE period_id=$1 ORDER BY project,indicator
sections.note: Unknown is not zero. Rates use pooled numerators and denominators. This working paper is not an audited service performance statement.

name: indicator-reference
title: Indicator reference sheet
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM indicators ORDER BY code

sections.title: Reporting history
sections.sql: SELECT project,period,target,actual,accepted,pending FROM v_reporting_desk WHERE indicator_id=$1 ORDER BY starts_on,project

name: partner-return
title: Partner reporting return
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM projects ORDER BY code

sections.title: Project and intended outcome
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,outcome FROM projects WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Expected returns
sections.sql: SELECT indicator,period,owner,due_on,target,actual,pending FROM v_reporting_desk WHERE project_id=$1 ORDER BY period,indicator

sections.title: Recorded context
sections.sql: SELECT note,actor,created_at FROM notes WHERE project_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at
